verdict.rationale: Both diffs make the same correct change to `mergeContacts`: a Map from normalized email to its first index, updated as new contacts are appended. That keeps first-match, intra-upload merging and append order unchanged. A also adds a test for repeated emails in the stored book and a scale test, and reports running tests and typecheck. B adds no tests, ran nothing, and its report ends with a garbled, meaningless sentence.
a_issues: The speed test uses a wall-clock limit that could be flaky on slow CI (the report says so).
b_issues: No tests protect the new Map-based behavior, such as first-match with repeated stored emails.
Nothing was run or typechecked; the report admits this.
The report has a garbled sentence ('This follows -style cleanup only loosely').
